body:
Powerful fey sometimes imbue their own innate power into a living creature they favor.

Rebuild Rules:

Ability Scores +4 to Dexterity
DR (1/2 the creature’s HD, minimum 1)/cold iron;
Senses gain low-light vision;
Type base creature and fey (treated as both)
